title: pm-dispatch: the wave-checkpoint rule gates the next wave on a maintainer-executed /compact — over-broad for remote sessions; keep the flush, drop the human gate
body:
Filed and claimed by the `repo:objectui` seat (session `session_01RnQd8iMMUwXQEV1crFmQiQ`, 2026-08-15) under the maintainer direct-command channel — the maintainer challenged this rule in the live PM session. Verbatim provenance (untranslated, 2026-08-14/15, this session):

> 「继续，加快进度，最多并发5个子任务」
> 「哪里来的波次纪律？为什么要等我执行压缩，你乱说的吧？」
> 「你说你承认"在本环境里执行得过于机械"，以后还会遇到这种问题等我而中断？」

## The defect

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, section 轮次报告与节奏, sub-section **波次收工点(维护者 2026-08-09 裁定)** prescribes: ① 收工点 = 在飞归零 → ② 存档 flush → ③ `/compact` 由维护者执行 → ④ 压缩后再派下一波,⛔ 不抢派.

Steps ③④ were written for terminal PM sessions, where `/compact` is human-only and a mid-review auto-compaction can lose in-context judgments. Applied literally in a **remote session** (auto-summarized, often unattended), they convert a safety checkpoint into an idle stop waiting for a human who is not watching — measured in this seat's session: the seat halted at in-flight-zero on 2026-08-14 until the maintainer asked why it had stopped, twice.

## The amendment (direction, for the drafting dev)

- **Keep** ① and ② unchanged — the in-flight-zero checkpoint and the flush-judgments-to-GitHub obligation are correct everywhere (they are what makes ANY compaction, manual or automatic, lossless).
- **Replace** ③④: after the flush, the seat **proceeds to the next wave immediately**. A maintainer-executed `/compact` at a flush point remains a terminal-session optimization the maintainer may perform, never a dispatch precondition. ⛔ Waiting for it is removed.
- Preserve the existing provenance format: the 2026-08-09 ruling stays cited as superseded-in-part by the 2026-08-14/15 ruling quoted above.

## Constraints (binding, from the skill's own guardrails)

- The skill's line-count ratchet (`check:pm-skill-ratchet`) only goes down — the rewrite must be net non-increasing.
- No issue numbers in operational text (`check:pm-skill-id-lint`).
- Any card touching `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` runs on `claude-fable-5` (mandatory tiering clause).
- Skills changes are ADR-class: the PR is drafted and pushed by the dev, reviewed by this seat on the card, and **left hanging for the maintainer's manual merge** — the AI never merges/queues it. That merge is the maintainer's veto window on this very amendment.
